title: ansible.project Facet
description: The OBSERVED definition of an AWX/AAP Project — the content root a job template runs FROM — projected read-only by the ansible-automation Connector's controller half (§1.2, AWX-001, ADR-0154). An observed foreign object, never a Stratt Named Kind. IT EXISTS TO REPAIR A SIGNAL, not merely to add breadth: ADR-0085's orphan-template Baseline reads the presence of the cross-source `ansible.template --runs--> ansible.playbook` edge, whose target is keyed by the Project's NAME concatenated with a playbook path and matched against an operator-set STRATT_ANSIBLE_CONTENT_ID. When that convention is broken the edge drops — byte-identically to it dropping because the content genuinely is not projected. One signal, two very different causes, and no way to tell them apart (§1.8). The template now also carries `uses-project`, joined on the ID AWX ISSUED rather than on a name a human aligned, so a dropped `runs` edge can be diagnosed: the project is right there with its scmUrl and scmRevision, and the missing half is the content root. scmRevision is the commit AWX last synced — the only fact in the mirror that says which BYTES the Controller is running, binding catalogue to execution (ADR-0127 D4's phrase). It is projected as an OBSERVATION and compared to nothing: the content half reads a filesystem and projects no revision, so there is no second value to diff, and claiming a drift check that cannot be computed is the plausible-wrong-answer this repo refuses; the comparison is a follow-up, booked rather than implied. §2.5 ON scmUrl: AWX stores repository credentials as a separate object, but a real estate routinely embeds a PAT in the clone URL (https://user:token@host/…), so the userinfo is REMOVED and scmUrlRedacted says so. Dropping the URL entirely would lose which repository — the fact most needed — to guard a minority case; projecting it verbatim would import live tokens. The boolean matters as much as the redaction: silently stripping would leave a reader unable to tell a clean URL from a scrubbed one, and 'this repository is cloned with an embedded credential' is itself worth surfacing. A value that cannot be parsed AND contains an `@` is withheld entirely, because a value that cannot be proven safe is not one to project. Project SYNC JOBS are deliberately not mirrored (run history, §3); status + lastUpdated carry the current state, the same current-not-history line ADR-0128 D3 drew for templates. Closed (§9).

scmType.description: git | hg | svn | archive, or empty for a MANUAL project (a directory on the Controller, which by definition no content root mirrors)

scmUrl.description: the clone URL with any embedded credential removed (§2.5); empty when the value could not be proven free of one

scmUrlRedacted.description: something was taken out of scmUrl — a credential was embedded in it, or the value was unparseable and withheld. Its own finding, not just a caveat.

scmRevision.description: the commit AWX last synced — which BYTES the Controller is running. Observed, compared to nothing.

status.description: the project's current sync state (successful | failed | never updated | …) — current, never history
